Our eBooks have not been tested on other dedicated eBook readers and eBook functionality may not operate as intended. Note: Turn off full justification and auto-hyphenation for best viewing results. Refer to Downloading IRS eBooks to your device and Helpful hints for viewing IRS eBooks for more information.
